bibliographic-data.invention-title: TEILEN UND VERWENDEN VON PASSERN ODER KONTEN
PARTAGE ET UTILISATION DE PASSES OU DE COMPTES
SHARING AND USING PASSES OR ACCOUNTS

abstract.p: The present disclosure generally relates to a computer system displaying user interfaces for accessing passes and transfer accounts. In some examples, passes are added to the computer system. In some examples, passes are accessed. In some examples, transfers relating to the passes and transfer accounts are displayed, such as in search user interfaces.
